subject: Future Tech
title: The Graveyard of AV Startups
description: A fast breakdown of The Graveyard of AV Startups for builders.

hook.text: Argo AI raised $3.6 billion, then shut down overnight in 2022. The AV industry's failure rate is staggering.

buildup.text: Uber sold its AV division. Apple canceled its car project after 10 years.

discovery.text: Building AVs requires billions, decades of patience, and tolerance for zero revenue.

twist.text: Each failure taught the industry something. Uber proved robotaxis are viable.

climax.text: The survivors—Waymo, Tesla, Baidu—learned from the fallen.

punchline.text: Many died so that a few could drive themselves.

quiz.question: What happened to Argo AI despite $3.6 billion in funding?
